verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes a temporary crypto-only launch configuration in which fiat payment is unavailable until added later; the administrative one-week estimate is not encoded.
The client specifies payment-selection gating: ETH must be selectable, while the unimplemented Card method must not be selectable; no prior attribute becomes obsolete.
First concrete failure of payment-method gating: ETH was unavailable while the unimplemented Card option was selectable.
